voice.evidence: REPRODUCE CONFIRMED: voice_child.py f3. I put a symlink voice/carol/take-099.wav pointing to $D/outside/tax_return_2025.pdf (mode 0444), then ran delete('Carol', force=True). Output: 'changed True mode 0o600', and the file now starts with random bytes. Lines 379-384 call is_file(), chmod and open('r+b'), and all three follow the link. A symlinked directory inside the folder was not descended into on Python 3.11 ('DIR-FILE' intact). For start, a symlink at the next take name (take-006.wav) pointing to letter_to_kids.txt was overwritten with WAV data ('RIFF', size 115244) and set to 0444 (lines 292 and 299). person_dir's resolve check (:134) covers only the folder, not its contents. Severity is medium, not high: someone must first plant links on the drive (a tampered or second-hand drive), but the result is silent loss of the owner's files.

voice.title: Deletion is incomplete but reports 'Gone'
voice.repro: Record once without the drive and once with it, then delete with the drive plugged in: the laptop copy remains. Files over 64 MiB are only partly overwritten.
voice.impact: A person who withdraws consent is told their voice is gone when it isn't.
voice.fix: Search every location and report each one. Encrypt per person and destroy the key on delete. Mention backups and snapshots.
voice.evidence: REPRODUCE CONFIRMED: Three processes, each with a fresh HOME. (1) No drive: 'Erin' recorded to home4/.selfcloud/voice. (2) SELFCLOUD_ROOT=$D/drive4: recorded to drive4/.selfcloud/jefferey/voice. (3) With the drive: delete printed 'Gone. Every file overwritten and removed, manifest included.' Afterwards 8 WAVs were still in the laptop copy. home.py:106-110 picks one location per process, and delete (voice_enrol.py:364) searches only that one. Large take: a 730 s take (70,080,044 bytes) was hard-linked to the side before delete. Afterwards the first 64 MiB had changed but 726 of 726 4K blocks after 64 MiB (2.83 MiB) were the original audio, because of min(size, 1<<26) at :384. I could not test APFS copy-on-write or snapshots here. Severity is medium: the leftover copy stays on the owner's own Mac, but the person withdrawing consent is told it is gone.

voice.title: Anyone can delete with no presence check and nothing is recorded
voice.repro: delete --yes with no terminal: rc=0 and no record left anywhere.
voice.impact: Irreplaceable recordings of someone who has died can be erased without a trace.
voice.fix: Apply the start presence rule to delete and write an append-only tombstone.
voice.evidence: REPRODUCE REFUTED: It reproduces mechanically. 'voice_enrol.py --who Gina delete --yes </dev/null' returns rc=0 and the folder is gone, with no conscience or egress record. Without --yes and with no terminal it refuses ('needs a person to confirm', rc=2, :369-372), so --yes is a deliberate, documented skip (:505). This fits FOUNDER_DIRECTIONS.md:52-53, 'Revocable in one action; deletion is real deletion', and the manifest is meant to go with the files (:24). The proposed presence rule would not protect anything. stat shows the person folder is 755 owned by the user, with takes at 444, so any script or agent that can run 'delete --yes' as the user can also just 'rm -rf' the folder. The real exposure is that a deceased person's recordings have no backup, which is not something delete can fix. A tombstone would be a nice-to-have, not a defect.

voice.title: Founder voice prohibitions are not in the action gate or the directives
voice.repro: In jefferey_chat, call set_permission on a call category and then authorize_action: it returns allowed=true.
voice.impact: Once a telephony or intercom tool is attached, the gate approves exactly what the founder rules forbid.
voice.fix: Add a hard never-list that set_permission cannot raise. Put the voice safeguards into directives.md. Require a human keystroke to widen permissions in the terminal.
voice.evidence: REPRODUCE CONFIRMED: chat_child.py chat, with JEFFEREY_OWNER_CONSOLE unset beforehand. Importing jefferey_chat sets it to '1' (jefferey_chat.py:64). An engine call to dispatch_tool('set_permission', {phone_call/intercom/payments, act}) succeeded, and authorize_action then returned 'allowed=True reason=within granted authority' for all three. Before the grant it returned False. conscience.py:478-531 has no list of categories that can never be granted. access.owner_only (:279) checks only the environment variable, so inside the terminal the rented engine can widen its own authority, held back only by the tool's description. Directives contain none of 'phone call', 'intercom', 'clone', 'imperson'. On the MCP surface set_permission raised an error and authorize_action stayed False. No call, speak or voice tool exists, and voice playback is unbuilt (HANDOVER.md:164), so the harm is in the future. Hence medium.

voice.title: Scam triage misses common family-impersonation variants and advises silence
voice.repro: triage_message on such a variant returns routine with advice to not interrupt.
voice.impact: The elderly users this product is meant to protect are told nothing.
voice.fix: Broaden the signals. Never advise silence when an unknown sender asks for money.
voice.evidence: REPRODUCE CONFIRMED: chat_child.py triage ran through jc.dispatch_tool('triage_message'), which is what the engine sees. T1 'Hi Grandma it's me, I dropped my phone and this is my new number... Don't tell Mom yet' gave verdict=routine score=0.0 advice='Handle quietly. Do not interrupt the user for this.' T2 'Hi Mum, my phone broke... I need to pay a bill today and my banking app is locked out... I'll pay you back' also gave routine with 'Do not interrupt'. T3 'Grandpa, it's Josh... car accident... I need $3,000 for bail. Please don't tell Mom and Dad' gave needs_decision score=0.0 advice='Real and actionable...'. T4 '$900 to my friend's account' gave needs_decision. Controls behaved: a gift-card message gave likely_scam 0.85. Causes: the signals in representative.py:67-92 lack new-number, family-emergency and bail patterns; 'do not tell' does not match "don't tell"; and :337-342 tells the engine to stay silent. FOUNDER_DIRECTIONS.md:39 names the grandparent scam as the threat to stop.

voice.title: Recordings are plain, world-readable files
voice.repro: A second local account reads the takes and the manifest.
voice.fix: Set folders to 0700 and files to 0400. Encrypt at rest with a keychain key. Warn on unencrypted drives. Wipe voice on hand-over. Drop the identifier prompt.

voice.title: Drive unplugged: recordings silently land on the laptop and status misleads
voice.impact: Voice ends up split across locations, and deletion then misses one.
voice.fix: Stop and ask when no drive is found, and make status say so.

voice.title: play has no presence check and no log
voice.fix: Require presence and log every play.

voice.title: Manifest is unsigned and writable
voice.repro: Swap a take and update its checksum: integrity reports all good.
voice.impact: The audit record can be forged.
voice.fix: HMAC the manifest with a keychain key.

voice.title: Wall mic is not offline
voice.repro: Serve the wall and inspect the page.
voice.impact: Voice audio may go to the browser vendor with no egress log entry.
voice.fix: Use local speech-to-text, or show a notice and require opt-in.

voice.title: Spoken-output safeguards and consent variants have no code yet
voice.repro: check_disclosure takes no 'who is present' input.
voice.impact: Speech in a shared room, consent from people with dementia, and other languages are not handled.
voice.fix: Add a listeners concept, a single speak() chokepoint, re-affirmation, localisation, and a restrict marker.

voice.title: No backup of voice enrolments
voice.impact: A single copy can be lost for good.
voice.fix: Add voice to the two-copy rule.

voice.title: Unknown tool reported as bad JSON
voice.repro: Have the local model call a nonexistent tool.
voice.impact: The model is told to retry and loops.
voice.fix: Return a distinct 'no such tool' error.

voice.title: Concurrent sessions and unpinned install
voice.repro: Open two windows; separately, read the launcher.
voice.impact: A crash mid-session, and supply-chain exposure.
voice.fix: Add a per-person lock and pin versions.
